purpose: Qualify separate original Olson 2014 GB1 ~55-site real single/double mutant count source for a future frozen native factorized shared-weight vs fully fitted conventional comparison. This gate only checks source custody and genotype metadata; no numeric effects or machine learning.
distinct_predecessors: WSP-193 Protein G Source size INVALID
WSP-195/196 Wu 2016 GB1 four-position candidate NO_GO PR1311; Olson 2014 GB1 has 55 mutable sites and separate original study assays; avoid contamination, never recycle WSP196 held outcomes

source.original_research: Olson et al. 2014, GB1 double-mutant mutational scan; source also reprocessed by Schmiedel & Lehner 2019
source.original_license: Repository LICENSE must be reviewed separately from published measurement data reuse rights; original measurements not copied to Yggdrasil
source.byte_route_issue: GitHub connector exposes original Git blob and byte length via metadata, but fetch_file range of >21MB doubles returns empty content; original measurements not verified in running environment.

metadata_parser.only_fields: Single first 3 TSV fields (WT amino acid, Position, Mutation), double first 6 (WT_AA1, Pos1, Mut1, WT_AA2, Pos2, Mut2), WT FASTA sequence string. Never parse input/selection count and fitness columns.
metadata_parser.gene_mutation_positions: Use exact published GB1 FASTA, 56 residues. Check 1-indexed site/reference allele match, canonical unordered pairs by position plus substitution, and row count; do not infer effects from counts.
metadata_parser.noncanonical: Fail closed on missing headers, invalid alphabet or sites, duplicate genotype, same site double, source drift. Preserve orphan/nonmatched mutations as explicit aggregates not silent exclusions.
metadata_parser.expected_schema: Author R script renames singles to WT_AA,Pos,Mut,count_r1_t0,count_r1_t1 and doubles first ten fields to WT_AA1,Pos1,Mut1,WT_AA2,Pos2,Mut2,count_r1_t0,count_r1_t1,fitness1,fitness2; original raw doubles may contain eight extra V11..V18 columns deleted by author R analysis.
metadata_parser.minimums: Freeze numerical FIT/VALID/DEV cohort minima in next distinct science prereg before opening count/fitness values; never tune this source-only gate on outcome.
metadata_parser.leakage: Do not use author-derived fitness1/fitness2 columns to select split, do not reuse public WSP196 4-site numerical scores as virgin, and no original-world first-use actions.

reproducibility.source_sha1_git_blob: SHA1('blob '+size+'\0'+entire_original_bytes) must equal four pinned blob IDs
reproducibility.sha256: Record independent SHA256 on verified bytes when available
reproducibility.receipt: Aggregate counts, genotype category counts, exact source fingerprints, no individual held mutation labels or observed fitness
reproducibility.regression: Focused source-free negative controls, followed by full original-code qualification on accepted source if authorized

next: Acquire authentic exact original double-mutant bytes through approved offline route; run source-admission checker; freeze novel factorized experiment prereg and fully fitted baseline controls before any numerical outcomes. Fail closed if byte route unavailable.
